changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.get_current_candle_direct(p_id_symbol integer, p_interval character varying) RETURNS character varying LANGUAGE sql AS $$ /* Return direction on last closed candle. */ select (case when k.o < k.c then 'up' when k.o > k.c then 'down' else 'unknown' end) from data.kline k where k.id_candle = ( select ci.id from data.candle ci where ci.id_symbol = p_id_symbol and ci.c_interval = p_interval and ci.start_ts is null ) order by k.ts_db desc limit 1; $$ ;
